subject.title: fix(signal): preserve newlines in debounced messages

question: Should this PR merge with test/CI-only evidence, or should it wait for redacted observed Signal receive/debounce proof showing the agent context contains real line breaks?
rationale: The branch fixes a channel-runtime behavior, but its body explicitly confirms no live Signal path was exercised; the protected `maintainer` label requires a human decision on whether that proof gap is acceptable.

options.title: Require Signal runtime proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until it includes a redacted terminal or bridge-log capture of a debounced Signal batch reaching the agent context with actual line breaks.

options.title: Accept focused proof
options.body: Merge based on the focused regression coverage and CI if a maintainer judges a live linked Signal account unnecessary for this low-risk string-separator correction.

recommendation.title: Require Signal runtime proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until it includes a redacted terminal or bridge-log capture of a debounced Signal batch reaching the agent context with actual line breaks.
